# Templates by Allan Ninal

> Free, MIT-licensed, mobile-first static website templates. One template shipped every day for a year (365 total). Each template is downloadable as a static-files ZIP (drop on any host) or full Astro source ZIP for customization. Live at templates.allanninal.dev.

## What this site is

A growing public gallery of distinct static website templates. Each template:

- Is 100% static HTML/CSS/JS (no backend, no SaaS dependencies, no email gates, no sign-ups)
- Is MIT-licensed (free for personal, commercial, or client work)
- Ships with a built static-files ZIP and a full Astro source ZIP
- Is mobile-first and fully responsive (tested at 375 / 768 / 1280 / 1920 px)
- Has light + dark mode end-to-end
- Has a unique design DNA — different palette, typography, density per niche

## Live templates

- [Developer Portfolio](https://templates.allanninal.dev/developer-portfolio/): Multi-page Astro + Tailwind portfolio. Dark-default zinc + warm amber accent. Inter + JetBrains Mono. Real MDX case studies (problem → approach → outcome → stack), MDX writing collection, RSS feed, schema.org Person.
- [SaaS Landing](https://templates.allanninal.dev/saas-landing/): Light-default Astro + Tailwind landing page. Violet → cyan accent gradient. Geist + Inter. Bento feature grid with HTML/CSS dashboard mocks (no stock photos), monthly/annual pricing toggle, FAQ accordion, schema.org SoftwareApplication with per-tier Offer nodes.

## Roadmap (365 niches over 12 thematic sprints)

- Sprint 1 — Audience Builders (Days 1–31): dev portfolio, SaaS, waitlist, link-in-bio, blog, docs, agency, etc.
- Sprint 2 — Food, Drink & Beauty (Days 32–59): pizzeria, bakery, brewery, salon, spa, tattoo studio
- Sprint 3 — Fitness & Trade Services (Days 60–90): yoga studio, plumber, electrician, mover, etc.
- Sprint 4 — Photography, Film, Music (Days 91–120)
- Sprint 5 — Designers & Studio Crafts (Days 121–150)
- Sprint 6 — Health, Medical, Wellness (Days 151–180)
- Sprint 7 — Legal, Financial, Property (Days 181–211)
- Sprint 8 — Education, Courses & Coaching (Days 212–242)
- Sprint 9 — Events & Family Milestones (Days 243–273)
- Sprint 10 — Content, Media & Creator Economy (Days 274–304)
- Sprint 11 — Independent Brands & Storefronts (Days 305–335)
- Sprint 12 — Civic, Travel, Seasonal & Capstone (Days 336–365)

## How to use a template

1. Visit the template's page (e.g. https://templates.allanninal.dev/developer-portfolio/).
2. Click "Download static (HTML/CSS/JS)" if you want files to upload to any host without a build step.
3. Click "Source (Astro)" if you want the full Astro project to customize.
4. To deploy to GitHub Pages: unzip the source, push to your own repo, enable Pages → GitHub Actions.
